content: Lightweight CSV-to-DB ETL patterns quarantine invalid rows into a separate error table/file with row number, original content, error reason, and timestamp rather than crashing the load; a common pattern is a relaxed staging table to land raw data before promoting valid rows to the target schema. Chunked/bulk loaders (e.g. BulkFlow for CSV->Postgres) implement chunk-based processing, connection pooling, and resumable/idempotent state tracking keyed on import progress so interrupted loads don't reprocess completed chunks.
